title: 第5章 劝谏
content_zh:
女孩儿猛地睁开眼，脸上的惊恐之色犹在，面前的枪口也不曾移动半分，但她却好像忘了这些似的，止不住惊讶的望向秦朗。

也不怪她如此惊讶，打从进门看到秦朗开始，她就已经初步对秦朗建立了懦弱不堪的印象。所以她根本想不到，在她面临性命之忧的时候，这个看似不堪大用的男生，竟敢开口劝说已经失去理智的赵铁柱。

“难道我连一个普普通通的学生都不如么？这还是我么？这还是警校各项成绩名列第一的白无瑕么？”

受到秦朗的刺激，女孩儿擂鼓一般的心跳，逐渐平复下来。回想刚刚自己糟糕的表现，她心里止不住的自责和懊恼。

女孩儿叫白无瑕，身份毋庸置疑，确确实实是一名人民警察，而且还是警察序列中，危险系数极高的刑警。

一般的女孩子即便是从警校毕业，也大都选择一些文职方向，但白无瑕却不愿如此，当年她不顾父亲的反对，坚持要读警察学校，目的就是要像哥哥那样，做一名刑警，完成哥哥未能走完的路。

正是抱着这样的想法，白无瑕从入校第一天起，就严格要求自己，刻苦学习和训练，凭着顽强的毅力，她在这个几乎是以男性为尊的行当里，闯出了女性的骄傲，力压群雄，以全校第一的优异毕业。

这样的成绩，她完全可以有更好的去路，可是她不愿意接受父亲的安排，在一个闲适的位置上，安心等着升官。跟父亲吵了一架后，她就离开省城，在父亲鞭长莫及的平安市做了一名普普通通的刑警。

这次劫持案，是她主动请缨要求由她来扮演这个送餐的角色，尽管高队长对她的经验表示怀疑，但她还是以自信和学校的优异成绩说服了对方。

她本想让自己在这个从警生涯中第一次接触的案子中，来个开门红，却没想到最终的表现竟是如此糟糕，不仅失误不断，甚至在面临枪口的时候，她竟然像个手足无措的小女生般懦弱。

“学校果然仅仅只是学校，所谓的成绩和实打实的经验比起来，根本就不算什么。可笑我竟然一直自视甚高，以为自己多了不起。”

白无瑕暗自苦笑，但眼前的情况，已经不可能给她后悔的机会了，失去理智的赵铁柱随时都有可能开枪，而唯一的转机就在那个男生身上。

这个时候，赵铁柱也回过神来，瞪着一双猩红的眼睛，危险的看着秦朗。

“我说换我就不杀她。”秦朗不急不缓的说道：“你杀了她，只能让你完全失去掣肘外面那些警察的资本。”

“笑话，老子就算杀了她，不是还有你在手上么？”赵铁柱冷笑道。

“不不不。”秦朗摇头道：“她和我大不相同，我只是个普普通通的学生，但她却是个警察。外面那些警察不可能坐视自己的同僚被杀，到时候即便你拿我当人质，恐怕那些警察也会放弃营救人质的想法，不顾一切的冲进来，将你当场击毙。”

听到这话，赵铁柱的神色开始变幻起来，脸上的疯狂也隐隐消散了起来。

秦朗见状，不由暗喜，他知道自己赌对了。

如果任由对方击杀这个女警，他的处境就会陷入到极度危险的地步，随时都有可能丧命。

偏偏他现在所蓄积的气力，还不足以达到爆发的程度，为了自己的性命着想，所以他不得不硬着头皮站出来，压制住赵铁柱枪杀女警的举动。

其实说出这样的话，他心里也捏了一把汗，因为他在赌，赌这个赵铁柱虽然是个疯子，但骨子里却是个贪生怕死的人。

眼看赵铁柱杀人的想法明显动摇，秦朗知道机不可失，连忙继续劝说道：“如果你留着她的性命，反而会对你更加有利。有警察作为人质，比挟持我这样一个普通学生，可更有威慑力。”

沉默了半晌，赵铁柱终于点点头道：“你小子说的还算是有道理，也好，老子现在就暂且不杀人。”

听到这话，不论是秦朗还是白无瑕都松了一口气。

“不过……”赵铁柱的眼睛突然眯了起来，毒蛇一般盯着秦朗道：“我怎么发现你小子好像有点不对劲。”

秦朗心头一紧，他自然知道赵铁柱所指的不对劲是什么。他已经两度开口点拨对方，而且说话的口气平稳淡定，完全不像是一个懦弱胆小的高中生。

其实他也明白，将自己伪装成一个胆怯的模样，更容易迷惑赵铁柱。只是，以他的性格，根本不可能低声下气的去扮演一个小瘪三。

“我也是为我自己的性命着想。你杀了她，让那些警察放弃营救人质的想法，不等于给我也判了死刑么？”秦朗缓缓道。

赵铁柱想想，觉得是这个道理，加上环境的压力，让他来不及细想，便警告道：“你小子最好给我放聪明点，要是敢跟我耍花样，老子就要你的小命。”

说完，他又朝白无瑕点了点枪口，喝骂道：“你们这些女人都是天生的贱货，等老子腾出手来，再好好收拾你跟梅语嫣那个臭婊子。现在，你给我过去蹲下。”

死里逃生的白无瑕，面对枪口的威胁，自然不敢轻举妄动，小心翼翼的走到秦朗身边蹲了下来。

赵铁柱见俩人都在自己的控制之下，心里稍安，再看到手中的枪，底气就更足了。

目光在白无瑕的身上流转了几圈，赵铁柱觉得还是不够放心，威胁了一声不许乱动，便在教室里翻找起来。

没过多久，他就在门后的卫生角，翻出了几根废弃的跳绳。

“你给我过来。”赵铁柱拿枪朝秦朗指了指。

“拿着这些跳绳去把那个贱货绑起来，记住，全身都要绑，打死结！”赵铁柱把几根跳绳扔到秦朗手上。

在他眼里，白无瑕的威胁比秦朗大得多，虽然白无瑕受了伤，可那都是皮肉之伤，只有将她绑死，才能让他彻底放心。

秦朗默默的接过跳绳，走回到白无瑕的身边。

这时候他已经能感觉到身上的气力蓄积了三成左右，距离达到爆发的条件已经越来越近，现在需要的就是拖住时间。

只不过，随着换元呼吸法的不断运转，他脑子里时不时的开始产生一种眩晕感，连带着身体四肢也时常抽筋似的抖动几下，好像生命元力已经不够使用似的。

“奇怪！换元呼吸法所需要的元力，根本微乎其微，难道这具身体连这点儿生命元力都不够？”

这种时候，秦朗也不可能分心去自查身体，所以他只能将疑问压在心里，目光放在了近在咫尺的白无瑕身上。
content_en:
The girl opened her eyes suddenly, the look of fear on her face was still there, and the muzzle of the gun in front of her did not move even half a minute, but she seemed to have forgotten this and couldn't help looking at Qin Lang in surprise.

It's no wonder she was so surprised. From the moment she saw Qin Lang when she entered the door, she had already formed an initial impression of Qin Lang as a coward.Therefore, she never imagined that when she was facing the fear of her life, this seemingly useless boy would dare to persuade Zhao Tiezhu, who had lost his mind.

"Am I not even as good as an ordinary student? Is this still me? Is this still Bai Wuxia who ranks first in all aspects of the police academy?"

Stimulated by Qin Lang, the girl's heart beat like a drum and gradually calmed down.Thinking back to her poor performance just now, she couldn't help but feel guilty and annoyed.

The girl's name is Bai Wuxia, and there is no doubt about her identity. She is indeed a people's policeman, and she is also a criminal police officer with a high risk factor in the police hierarchy.

Even after graduating from the police academy, most girls would choose some civilian career, but Bai Wuxia was unwilling to do this. She ignored her father's objections and insisted on attending the police academy. The purpose was to be a criminal police officer like her brother and complete the path that his brother failed to complete.

It is with this idea in mind that Bai Wuxia has been strict with herself since the first day she entered the school, studying and training hard. With her tenacious perseverance, she has become a woman's pride in this industry that is almost dominated by men, outperforming the others, and graduating with the highest honors in the school.

With such achievements, she could definitely have a better career, but she was unwilling to accept her father's arrangement and wait for promotion in a comfortable position.After a quarrel with her father, she left the provincial capital and became an ordinary criminal police officer in Ping'an City, which was beyond her father's reach.

In this kidnapping case, she took the initiative to ask Ying to play the role of delivering food. Although Captain Gao expressed doubts about her experience, she still convinced him with her confidence and excellent grades in school.

She wanted to get off to a good start in this case, which was her first contact in her police career, but she didn't expect her final performance to be so bad. Not only did she make constant mistakes, she even acted as cowardly as a helpless little girl when faced with a gun.

"School is just a school after all. The so-called achievements are nothing compared with the real experience. It's ridiculous that I always think highly of myself and think I am so great."

Bai Wuxia secretly smiled bitterly, but the situation in front of her could no longer give her a chance to regret. Zhao Tiezhu, who had lost his mind, might shoot at any time, and the only turning point was with that boy.

At this time, Zhao Tiezhu also came back to his senses, staring at Qin Lang dangerously with a pair of scarlet eyes.

"I said I wouldn't kill her." Qin Lang said unhurriedly: "If you kill her, you will completely lose the ability to control the police outside."

"What a joke, even if I kill her, won't I still have you in my hand?" Zhao Tiezhu sneered.

"No, no, no." Qin Lang shook his head and said, "She is very different from me. I am just an ordinary student, but she is a policeman. It is impossible for the policemen outside to sit back and watch their colleagues being killed. Even if you take me as a hostage, I am afraid those policemen will give up the idea of rescuing the hostages, rush in desperately, and kill you on the spot."

After hearing this, Zhao Tiezhu's expression began to change, and the madness on his face also faded away.

When Qin Lang saw this, he couldn't help but secretly rejoiced. He knew that he had made the right bet.

If the other party is allowed to kill the policewoman, his situation will be extremely dangerous and he may die at any time.

However, the strength he had accumulated now was not enough to explode. For the sake of his own life, he had to stand up and suppress Zhao Tiezhu's action of shooting the policewoman.

In fact, he was sweating in his heart when he said such words, because he was betting that although Zhao Tiezhu was a madman, he was actually a person who was greedy for life and afraid of death.

Seeing that Zhao Tiezhu's idea of killing was obviously shaken, Qin Lang knew that the opportunity was too late and quickly continued to persuade: "If you keep her alive, it will be more beneficial to you. Having a policeman as a hostage is more of a deterrent than taking an ordinary student like me."

After being silent for a long time, Zhao Tiezhu finally nodded and said: "What you said makes sense, so I won't kill anyone for now."

Upon hearing this, both Qin Lang and Bai Wuxia breathed a sigh of relief.

"But..." Zhao Tiezhu's eyes suddenly narrowed, staring at Qin Lang like a poisonous snake and said: "How did I find that there seems to be something wrong with you, kid?"

Qin Lang's heart tightened. He naturally knew what was wrong with what Zhao Tiezhu was referring to.He had already spoken to the other party twice, and his tone of voice was calm and calm, not like a timid high school student at all.

In fact, he also understood that it was easier to confuse Zhao Tiezhu by disguising himself as timid.However, with his character, it is impossible for him to play the role of a loser in such a humble manner.

"I'm also thinking about my own life. If you kill her and make the police give up the idea of ​​rescuing the hostages, doesn't that mean you've sentenced me to death?" Qin Lang said slowly.

Zhao Tiezhu thought about it and felt that this was the truth. Coupled with the pressure of the environment, he had no time to think carefully, so he warned: "You better be smarter. If you dare to play tricks with me, I will kill you."

After saying that, he pointed his gun at Bai Wuxia again and cursed: "You women are all born bitches. When I have my hands free, I will take care of you and Mei Yuyan, that stinky bitch. Now, go over and squat down."

Bai Wuxia, who had narrowly escaped death, naturally did not dare to act rashly when faced with the threat of a gun. He cautiously walked to Qin Lang and squatted down.

Zhao Tiezhu felt a little relieved when he saw that both of them were under his control. When he saw the gun in his hand, he felt even more confident.

After his eyes wandered around Bai Wuxia's body for several times, Zhao Tiezhu felt that he was still not reassured enough, so he threatened not to move, and started rummaging around in the classroom.

Not long after, he dug out a few discarded skipping ropes in the sanitary corner behind the door.

"Come here." Zhao Tiezhu pointed the gun at Qin Lang.

"Take these skipping ropes and tie up that bitch. Remember, the whole body must be tied up and the knot will be tied!" Zhao Tiezhu threw a few skipping ropes into Qin Lang's hands.

In his eyes, Bai Wuxia was a much greater threat than Qin Lang. Although Bai Wuxia was injured, they were all flesh injuries. Only by tying her to death could he completely rest assured.

Qin Lang silently took the skipping rope and walked back to Bai Wuxia.

At this time, he could already feel that the energy in his body had accumulated about 30%, and he was getting closer and closer to reaching the conditions for explosion. All he needed now was to delay time.

However, as the Yuan Changing Breathing Method continued to operate, he began to feel dizzy from time to time in his mind, and his body and limbs often trembled like cramps, as if his life force was no longer enough.

"Strange! The energy required for the breathing method of changing energy is minimal. Could it be that this body doesn't even have enough life energy?"

At this time, it was impossible for Qin Lang to be distracted and check his body, so he could only keep his doubts in his heart and focus on Bai Wuxia, who was close at hand.
